mentions.name: Event-Driven Architecture framework for Kotlin
mentions.description: An event-driven architecture framework for Kotlin. The author is building it by dissecting the TypeScript companion framework (aws-lambda-stream) from the Software Architecture Patterns for Serverless Systems book and converting it piece by piece to Kotlin, which makes the ideas easier to apply in real life and clarifies how everything fits together.
mentions.problem: After studying the book, the author still had doubts about actually using its event-driven architecture ideas in real life, so building a Kotlin port of the companion framework helps understand how the pieces fit together.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on creating an Even Driven Architecture framework for Kotlin.
